In my view, trending into, if not already in the bear market. And also a lot of changes have occurred. If you guys remember, if you guys have been on my channel for any length of time, one of the first early investors in this protocol and started to learn about it is basically the protocol pumped and dumped after 2017. And then what we saw was massive development through that bear market. And then in 2020, the introduction of staking... Liquid staking protocol and basically this made Cardano the first blockchain in the top 50 I would say that actually created incentivized staking for crypto for the holders and then it spread to the rest of crypto. But then we started to see some hiccups. We started to see some hiccups with integrations, with interoperability, with stable coins, and this started to make me nervous. We saw the integration and launch of smart contracts back in 2021, and then the macro market started to fall, and since then, Cardano still to this day has not reached these all-time record highs. But now, we are in a new market a new cycle, and really a new regulatory environment with a lot of acceptance around crypto and a lot of integrations with traditional finance and so this brings us to today's video, which is by the way and members-only video.
